description: JARVIS v7.0 MCP server registry. The router loads enabled entries, imports each module, and calls its get_server() factory. The n8n server uses a stdio bridge to the real czlonkowski/n8n-mcp npm package.

servers.name: filesystem
servers.description: Safe read/write filesystem access bounded by JARVIS_FS_ALLOWED_ROOTS.

servers.name: network
servers.description: HTTP(S), DNS, ping, TCP port check, and nmap (lab mode only).

servers.name: automation
servers.description: External automation: n8n webhook triggers + Apify actor runs.

servers.name: n8n
servers.description: n8n workflow automation via hybrid architecture: upstream czlonkowski/n8n-mcp stdio bridge (7 validation/docs tools) + local REST client (4 execution/workflow tools). Note: Workflow execution NOT supported by n8n public API - use n8n_trigger (automation_mcp) for webhook-based execution.

known_upstream.note: Upstream provides 7 validation/docs tools. Local REST provides 4 tools: execution history (2) + workflow management (2). N8n public API does NOT support workflow execution - use webhooks instead.

servers.name: computer-use
servers.description: Browser automation via Playwright: navigate, click, type, screenshot. Requires jarvis-xvfb Docker container.
